"PROJECT: OPERATION SHADOW – NEXT-GEN BATTLE ROYALE

Create a realistic, high-quality 3D PC Battle Royale shooter with the visual quality, immersive atmosphere and gameplay depth of PUBG PC.

The game must be visually impressive while maintaining a compact installation size and efficient resource usage.

GAME WORLD

Create a beautiful, realistic 3D map featuring:

- Abandoned modern city
- Military training facility
- Airport
- Dense forest
- Small villages
- River and bridges
- Underground bunkers
- Industrial warehouses

Use realistic terrain, detailed buildings, natural lighting and atmospheric effects.

GAMEPLAY

- 40 players per match, including intelligent AI bots.
- Solo Battle Royale.
- Spawn from a military transport aircraft.
- Parachute onto the island.
- Search buildings for weapons and equipment.
- Survive the shrinking danger zone.
- Eliminate opponents and become the last survivor.
- Include a complete victory and defeat system.

REALISTIC COMBAT

- Realistic first-person and third-person shooting.
- Smooth weapon animations.
- Advanced recoil and weapon sway.
- Realistic bullet travel and projectile physics.
- Weapon-specific firing rates and damage.
- Scope zoom and ADS mechanics.
- Bullet penetration where supported.
- Responsive hit detection and impact effects.

WEAPON ARSENAL

Include:

- M416-style assault rifle
- AK-style assault rifle
- SCAR-style rifle
- Bolt-action sniper rifle
- DMR
- SMG
- Shotgun
- Pistol
- Frag grenade and smoke grenade

Create original or properly licensed assets. Use optimized weapon models and reusable attachment systems.

REALISTIC VISUALS

- AAA-style realistic environment.
- High-quality PBR materials.
- Dynamic shadows and lighting.
- Realistic sky and clouds.
- Wind effects on vegetation.
- Detailed weapon and character models.
- Realistic muzzle flashes and smoke.
- Natural animation blending.
- High-quality but optimized textures.

PLAYER SYSTEM

- Sprinting
- Walking
- Crouching
- Prone movement
- Jumping
- Leaning
- Reloading
- Weapon switching
- Inventory management
- Armor and healing

SMART AI

Bots must:

- Loot nearby buildings.
- Search for useful equipment.
- Detect enemies intelligently.
- Take cover during combat.
- Avoid danger zones.
- Move strategically.
- Fight instead of remaining idle.

PERFORMANCE @COMMENT_BODY@ STORAGE

- Keep the game compact.
- Use compressed textures.
- Use low-poly models with high-quality materials where appropriate.
- Implement LOD and occlusion culling.
- Reuse assets intelligently.
- Avoid oversized unnecessary audio and video files.
- Optimize rendering and memory usage.
- Support Low, Medium, High and Ultra settings.
- Prioritize smooth FPS and responsive gameplay.

FINISHING REQUIREMENTS

Create a fully playable game, not just a cinematic environment or demo.

Implement a working main menu, lobby, match start, gameplay HUD, map, inventory, safe zone, AI combat, victory screen and restart functionality.

Test all major systems, fix errors and preserve working features.

FINAL VISION

A compact, visually impressive, realistic military Battle Royale PC game with immersive combat, premium graphics, satisfying shooting mechanics and smooth performance.

Focus on delivering a polished and complete experience instead of adding unnecessary features that increase project size or cause build failures.
"
